description: Source code for initializing and powering up SRAM banks (HPSRAM and LPSRAM) on Intel ADSP platform within Zephyr OS, including functions for bank power management and memory initialization.

methods.name: hp_sram_pm_banks
methods.description: Powers up specified number of HPSRAM banks and manages power gating.

methods.name: hp_sram_init
methods.description: Initializes HPSRAM based on memory size, powering up necessary banks.

methods.name: lp_sram_init
methods.description: Initializes LPSRAM, powering it on and zeroing memory.
